verdict.rationale: Capsule CRM documents an HTTPS API authenticated with Bearer tokens. Users can generate a token directly from their account instead of going through the interactive OAuth 2 flow, which supports non-interactive, headless scripted access from automation such as CI jobs. There is no CLI, no CI-specific guidance, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), so headless use is only possible through raw API calls. missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, documented CI/automation guidance, published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: API requests are made via HTTPS using the `api.capsulecrm.com` subdomain. Each request must be authenticated with a user's Bearer token.
you can generate a token directly from your Capsule account to avoid the oAuth 2 flow.
Use Capsule's API to integrate with your custom or third party application.
